subject: VM cadence confirmation & attestation pathing for BluePeak
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@bluepeak.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@bluepeak.com
Date: 2027-04-19T16:12:00Z
Subject: VM evidence & timeline for SOC2 SIG intake

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake, BluePeak needs a clear, witnessable pathway that shows your vulnerability management cadence and remediation SLAs for severity tiers. Specifically we need:

- A statement of your automated monthly/full-stack scan cadence and any weekly quick scans you run.
- SLA windows for P1/P2/P3 (remediation target + what constitutes an exception).
- An attestation letter we can reasonably include in the SIG matrix that commits Redwood to the stated timelines (we typically accept a signed DocuSign).
- A sample scan snapshot (last 90 days) and an example CVE remediation record showing triage -> patch -> verification dates.

For procurement and audit we prefer materials that can be cross-checked (links to snapshots, a minimal timeline spreadsheet, and a primary contact for remediation follow-up). Can you send this over by EOD tomorrow (Tue 20 Apr)? If you foresee any SLA carveouts we need to surface them now — BluePeak will request that exceptions be explained and have compensating controls documented.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Priya Shah
Senior Security Manager, BluePeak Bank
priya.shah@bluepeak.com
[Attachment: BP_SIG_Template.xlsx]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: VM evidence & timeline for SOC2 SIG intake

Hi Priya — thanks, will do. Quick summary of what we'll provide and a small operational note:

1) Scan cadence
- Full authenticated infrastructure + container image scans: weekly (every 7 days).
- Lightweight network and dependency quick scans: daily (automated), prioritized by published CVE severity.
- Monthly full-scope penetration-integrated scans run on the first Tuesday of each month (we'll include the last three snapshots).

2) SLA windows (standard)
- P1 (critical, remote code execution/exposed secrets): 72 hours to triage, 14 days to remediation where a patch is available, otherwise documented mitigation within 72 hours.
- P2 (high): 5 business days to triage, 30 days to remediation.
- P3 (medium/low): 30 calendar days to remediation; deferment allowed with documented compensating control.

Operational note (carveout): our hosted inference runtime occasionally requires staged rollouts for certain kernel-level fixes; for those we propose a documented "30-day carveout window" for P2->P3 items that affect runtime orchestration and require coordinated kernel/driver validation on GPU fleet. During that window we provide continuous mitigation telemetry and a rollback plan. If BluePeak requires a hard 30-day maximum without carveouts, we can align under an enterprise SLA amendment.

3) Deliverables we will attach
- scan-snapshot-20270401.pdf (sample vulnerability export, redacted for PII)
- vm-closure-schedule.xlsx (timeline template showing triage/patch/verify dates)
- A short attestation draft (one page) that we can finalize via DocuSign.

4) Contact and verification
- Ben Carter (Security Ops) will own evidence delivery and can provide live witness verification for a short call.

I'll send the attachments and a draft attestation in a follow-up within the hour. If that carveout above is a blocker, flag it and we'll escalate to Laura to discuss SLA amendment language.

— Markus Klein
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
[Attachment: vm-closure-schedule.xlsx]

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@bluepeak.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@bluepeak.com
Date: 2027-04-19T20:10:00Z
Subject: Re: VM evidence & timeline for SOC2 SIG intake

Markus — thanks for the clear breakdown. A couple quick points:

- The cadence looks reasonable. BluePeak's procurement legal team requires the carveout to be explicitly called out in an appendix with compensating controls and a maximum overall remediation commitment.
- For the sample snapshot: please ensure the PDF redacts customer identifiers and internal IPs; we only need the vulnerability ids, severities, discovery/triage/patch/verify timestamps, and owner.
- We can accept the 30-day carveout for kernel-level runtime fixes provided we see the compensating telemetry you mentioned and a rollback trigger.

Next steps: please send the draft attestation via DocuSign and the redacted snapshot. Also can Ben or you join a 30-minute call Wednesday 21 Apr at 15:00 ET to witness the evidence and walk our audit lead through the triage -> verify workflow?

Thanks — Priya

Priya Shah
Senior Security Manager, BluePeak Bank
[BluePeak procurement reference: BP-AUD-2027-04]
[Attachment requested: scan-snapshot-20270401.pdf]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: VM evidence & timeline for SOC2 SIG intake

Hi Priya — Laura here (Head of Product Ops). I can confirm a few clarifying items and I've approved the carveout language below for inclusion in the attestation appendix:

- Carveout scope: kernel/driver runtime patches that require staged fleet validation (typical for GPU runtime).
- Compensating controls: automated Canary validation, KV cache integrity checks, automated rollback triggers, and 24/7 on-call remediation.
- Maximum remediation commitment: 30 calendar days from triage for items in the carveout scope; all P1/P2 items outside the carveout remain subject to the standard windows above.

Ben will send the redacted PDF and the DocuSign attestation before EOD today. I can join the Wed 21 Apr 15:00 ET call if needed.

Best,

Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
[Attachment: scan-snapshot-20270401.pdf]
